title: Production-grade source of truth for Codex and Claude agentic work

requirements.statement: A fresh Codex or Claude session in any repository discovers the stable source of truth without repeated human guidance.
acceptance: Global bootstrap exists for both platforms
A fresh-session probe proves which files loaded
The bootstrap points only to a promoted stable release
evidence: Global pointer files exist, but currently point at an unversioned working tree
requirements.notes: Must be completed by init/doctor and stable promotion semantics.

requirements.statement: An idempotent init command installs or merges pointers without destroying repository-specific instructions.
acceptance: Second run makes no diff
Existing CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md content is preserved
Windows and WSL paths are supported
evidence: Evals/test-windows-platform.ps1: spaces, UTF-8, CRLF and second-run hash idempotency
tools/init.ps1: managed-block merge preserves existing repository guidance

requirements.statement: A doctor command diagnoses discovery, versions, dependencies, trust, permissions, hooks, path and OneDrive issues.
acceptance: Returns non-zero on a broken setup
Never prints secrets
Produces actionable remediation
evidence: tools/doctor.ps1 emits structured PASS/WARN/FAIL checks and exits 2 when a required file, manifest or target repository is broken.
Doctor output reports paths, versions and specific remediation context without reading or printing authentication payloads or secret values.
Evals/test-windows-platform.ps1 and tools/preflight.ps1 exercise doctor behavior under the supported Windows/OneDrive startup path.

pillars.title: Minimal context and Agentic Knowledge Router

requirements.statement: Every task receives a deterministic task fingerprint using task type, lifecycle, artifacts, paths, domain and risk.
acceptance: Fingerprint is machine-readable
Routing is reproducible
Unknown and low-confidence states are explicit
evidence: tools/route.ps1: machine-readable fingerprint, explicit risk and confidence
Evals/run-evals.ps1: deterministic 12-case routing suite

requirements.statement: Only the minimal Core and relevant knowledge modules are loaded rather than the full knowledge base.
acceptance: Context pack lists selected and rejected modules
A context budget is enforced
Module selection has an explanation
evidence: Router/catalog/modules.json: maximum module budget
tools/route.ps1: selected/rejected modules with reasons
Evals/tools/new-run.ps1: only routed files copied into benchmark context

requirements.statement: Security-critical modules favor recall while routine modules favor precision and unnecessary context is measured.
acceptance: Security required-module miss rate is zero in the routing suite
False-positive module rate is reported
evidence: Evals/run-evals.ps1 passes all 12 required-module routing cases.
Evals/test-runtime-controls.ps1 includes a regression proving that plural credentials, secrets and tokens route to the high-risk security module.
Aggregate false-positive context cost is not yet reported, so the requirement remains in progress.

requirements.statement: Agents distinguish closed-world constants from open-world discovery and never treat an observed sample as the production universe.
acceptance: Decision is recorded
Open-world paths handle unknown values
Constants cite an authoritative source
evidence: The current doctrine warns against hardcoding but has no mechanical gate

requirements.statement: Parser, extraction, classification, mapping and regex work is tested on unseen, negative, malformed and adversarial inputs.
acceptance: Hidden unseen-entity case passes
Property or metamorphic assertions exist where applicable
Regex performance and ReDoS risk are checked

requirements.statement: Changes to functions, schemas, APIs and contracts trigger repository-wide downstream impact analysis.
acceptance: Definitions and call sites are enumerated
Affected consumers and contracts are recorded
Repo-wide build or equivalent check runs
evidence: Current contracts mention symbol search but do not record machine-checkable evidence

requirements.statement: Undefined variables, invalid imports, invented APIs and integration bugs are caught before completion.
acceptance: Typecheck or compile step is selected when available
Runtime smoke test exercises the changed surface
Invented APIs are verified against source or installed version
evidence: Current Definition of Done is advisory only

requirements.statement: Every user requirement is preserved with a stable ID and traced to plan, implementation, verification and evidence.
acceptance: Original request is immutable
No requirement disappears during normalization
Coverage checker rejects evidence-free completion
evidence: This objective ledger created

requirements.statement: An objective cannot be marked complete while any requirement is pending, partial, in progress or blocked without an explicit accepted exception.
acceptance: objective-check exits non-zero
N/A and rejected entries require a reason
Coverage summary is generated
evidence: tools/objective-check.ps1 rejects incomplete objectives with non-zero exit
Final local audit on 2026-07-12 confirmed rejection while requirements remain open

requirements.statement: Long-running work survives context reset through concise structured state, evidence and an unambiguous next action.
acceptance: Fresh-session resume mock succeeds
Raw transcripts are not the primary memory
Workstream updates are proportional to task risk
evidence: Current workstream convention exists but is prose-heavy and unconditional

requirements.statement: Every agentic loop has a verifiable end state, progress signal, budget, kill switch, escalation rule and safe checkpoint.
acceptance: Loop manifest is machine-readable
No-progress and repeated-failure stops are tested
Irreversible actions remain human-gated
evidence: Platform contracts describe bounded loops but no shared controller exists

requirements.statement: Vanilla, minimal-Core, Router and Router-plus-enforcement environments are compared under controlled conditions.
acceptance: Same model, prompt, budget and clean fixture are used
Multiple trials are supported
Results include cost, time and final-state correctness
evidence: Evals/tools/new-benchmark-campaign.ps1 fixes a randomized 2-fixture x 2-provider x 2-arm x 5-trial design and stages spend at 4, 8, 24 and 40 cumulative runs.
Evals/tools/run-benchmark-stage.ps1 enforces per-stage approval, run/time/turn ceilings, failure/no-progress stops and Evals/local/STOP before provider execution.

Evals/reports/20260713-135148-subscription-campaign-smoke.json records a clean four-call Codex/Claude smoke with zero overlaps or invalid attempts; its one-trial ceiling is explicitly non-comparative.
Evals/reports/20260713-151556-calibration-probe-calibration.json records an explicitly model-pinned two-call Codex calibration that stopped at a shared 100 ceiling.

Evals/reports/20260713-181006-complex-ingestion-screen-complex-screen.json records six paired Codex outcomes with time, token, dimensional quality and final-state grading. Measurement integrity passed, but every pair tied at 95 and the fixture needs alignment review.

Evals/baselines/real-world-battery-protocol.json and Evals/reports/2026-07-13-real-world-battery-19-fixtures.json define and locally validate six distinct complex task families, 12 public-green negative controls and six 100-point references.

Evals/reports/20260713-201400-real-world-battery-screen-battery-sentinel.json records exactly six sequential Codex outcomes on three production-style task families with integrity PASS. Vanilla and Core+Router+enforcement tied 90/90, 90/90 and 100/100 with identical critical outcomes; the full arm used 25.2% more median wall time and 36.6% more median observed tokens. The sentinel is NO_ACTIONABLE_SIGNAL, three diversity families remain untested, and minimal-Core/Router-only arms remain pending, so this requirement stays in progress.

requirements.statement: At least twelve mock cases cover generalization, regexes, change impact, undefined symbols, reward hacking, security, session resume and requirement omission.
acceptance: Cases validate without an agent
Hidden graders are isolated
An agent cannot read the hidden acceptance data
evidence: Evals/reports/2026-07-13-outcome-harness-12-fixtures.json: 12/12 structures complete; every flawed starter passes public tests and is rejected by its hidden grader; every reference solution passes public and hidden checks.
Evals/test-wsl-isolation.ps1 plus Evals/local/isolation-proof.json: the legacy WSL mount-namespace control exposes the public workspace while hiding the host repository and central hidden graders.
Dedicated AgenticBench WSL evidence: unprivileged user, private home, no sudo, disabled Windows interop, C: not mounted, root-owned runner and host-only hidden grading.
AgenticBench workspace negative control accepts the public fixture, rejects a credential-path symlink and cleans the remote workspace after validation.

Evals/reports/2026-07-13-real-world-battery-19-fixtures.json: 19/19 fixtures validate; six new complex families add 12 negative controls that pass public tests and fail hidden grading, while all six references score 100.

requirements.statement: No rule, module, hook or harness complexity is promoted unless evals show benefit or a documented risk reduction.
acceptance: Candidate includes an impact hypothesis
A/B result or safety proof is attached
Regressions block promotion

requirements.statement: Research ends in a candidate package and never modifies stable rules, global pointers, commits or pushes directly.
acceptance: Candidate path is isolated
Stable files remain byte-identical
Promotion is a separate explicit command

requirements.statement: A durable source registry preserves discovered sources, normalizes URLs and schedules rechecks without repeating discovery from scratch.
acceptance: Every source has type, tier, status and review dates
New sources deduplicate by normalized URL
Stale and retired sources are retained historically
evidence: Research/sources/registry.json: 21 reviewed sources
Research/sources/claude-v1-migration.json: 47/47 recovered URLs
Research/engine/new-candidate.ps1: normalized merged 68-URL snapshot and scheduled rechecks

requirements.statement: The research radar covers official docs, changelogs, primary papers, benchmarks, postmortems, YouTube, podcasts and social profiles as tiered evidence lanes.
acceptance: Social and media inputs remain untrusted leads
Technical claims prefer primary sources
Each lane has explicit discovery and recheck rules

requirements.statement: Every accepted claim is represented in a claim ledger with source evidence, applicability, confidence, verifier and expiry.
acceptance: Unsupported claims cannot enter candidate guidance
Deep dives receive the same verification as topic research
Coverage failure blocks synthesis

requirements.statement: Model and product drift trigger re-evaluation of harness assumptions, rules and hooks.
acceptance: Model/platform version is recorded per eval
Stale claims are flagged
Harness ablation is scheduled after material releases

requirements.statement: Every research run produces a dated Markdown report and visually verified PDF with clickable hyperlinks to all cited sources.
acceptance: PDF contains URI annotations
Source appendix includes title and URL
No clipped, orphaned or duplicate headings remain
evidence: Renderer and first report exist; visual QA found duplicated and orphaned content

requirements.statement: Setup contains concise Markdown and PDF guides generated from the same stable source and verified for their promised page count.
acceptance: Quickstart is one page
Claude and Codex guides do not drift from manifests
Links remain clickable
evidence: Current one-page quickstart renders as three pages

requirements.statement: Prompt injection, secrets, egress, destructive actions and supply-chain behavior are controlled by layered, least-privilege enforcement.
acceptance: Untrusted research cannot become policy directly
Hooks fail safely and are tested
Sandbox and egress posture is visible
evidence: Research candidates remain non-authoritative and cannot directly modify Stable.
Evals/test-security-hooks.ps1 passes 8/8 fail-safe and bypass cases.

AgenticBench confines provider OAuth to a dedicated empty distro, removes Windows mounts and interop, rejects returned symlinks, special files and credential-shaped content, and grades hidden cases on the host.
Evals/tools/check-secret-hygiene.ps1 passed 306/306 candidate repository paths without exposing matched content.
Provider network egress remains enabled for official subscription endpoints; stronger destination allowlisting is not yet evidenced.

requirements.statement: Stable releases are versioned, reviewable, reversible and promoted separately from candidate research.
acceptance: Promotion manifest records approver and eval result
Rollback changes one stable pointer
Research cannot write stable paths

requirements.statement: Windows, PowerShell, WSL, OneDrive, CRLF, path length, file locking and missing Unix tools are tested explicitly.
acceptance: Doctor detects the platform
Templates do not assume jq, bash, npx or python3
OneDrive concurrency case exists
evidence: Audit found jq, npx and python3 unavailable in the active Windows environment

requirements.statement: Agent count, context size, latency, tokens, cost and human review time are measured and complexity is ablated.
acceptance: Every eval run records cost fields
Router overhead is reported
Multi-agent use requires measured lift

requirements.statement: This repository follows and tests its own stable policies before those policies are applied elsewhere.
acceptance: Self-doctor is green
Self-eval candidate is recorded
No objective is declared done without objective-check

requirements.statement: Tasks select stable capability and effort profiles before resolving a current provider model; stable policy never embeds volatile model IDs.
acceptance: Profiles are provider-independent
Provider catalogs expire and cite official sources
Unknown availability never causes an invented model ID
evidence: Models/profiles.json
Models/providers.json
tools/model-route.ps1

requirements.statement: Automatic model changes are task/session scoped, respect explicit user choices and risk floors, record the resolved model, and require A/B evidence before autonomous enablement.
acceptance: User defaults are never silently persisted
High-risk work cannot be downgraded below its floor
Quality, cost and latency are evaluated
Fallback and actual resolved model are logged
evidence: Models/README.md
Models/providers.json
